review.rationale: The Decision correctly supersedes only future execution of the fixed-count validation harness remediation, preserves the preflight failure reference and its SHA-256, and keeps all tracked JSON files in scope via a deterministic git ls-files --full-name manifest. It authorizes exactly one runtime-manifest-bound three-stage validation (tracked JSON parse/duplicate check, Commercial Entry Schema, and five-path cross-file consistency) with commit/push gated on complete PASS of all three stages. The frozen patch SHA-256 and exact five target paths are bound, no unrelated changes or authority elevations are permitted, and all non-authorizations are explicitly declared false. The temporary validator is constrained to untracked status and limited semantic scope. All boolean gates evaluate true, blockers and corrections are empty, and confidence exceeds the 0.90 threshold.
